correctness.rationale: Both independent exhaustive programs compute all 276 vertex witnesses for each edge pair in GP(8,3); test every 1820 four-set and 4368 five-set, and independently find zero robust four-sets and exactly sixteen robust five-sets, equal to the sixteen distinct size-five graph-distance-three spheres. Two-witness monotonicity gives the lower bound for all smaller sets; exact bipartite common-neighbor counts give pair intersections and k-reconfiguration shapes. Independent direct subset-deletion and bitmask approaches agree.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor cubic symmetric incidence graph is a natural canonical object; the sixteen robust optima all have an intrinsic distance-three-sphere interpretation and two-shore obstruction. This gives exact sensor-failure resilience and a sharp full-replacement barrier, a structural reliability/mobility contrast not implied by mere correctness of a finite census. Narrow but mathematically motivated. The 2020 source motivates the sharp plus-one fault-tolerance gap, attained here.
